To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Netflix adaptation to congestion is intertwined with underlying TCP mechanisms.

the Netflix application algorithm is intertwined with the underlying transport protocol, that the algorithm is not fully optimized to maximize throughput, and that the application algorithm is not fully robust to the presence of other flows sharing the same bottleneck.

(a) Netflix bandwidth consumption depends on both the network conditions and the underlying TCP implementation; (b) Netflix bandwidth consumption is significantly lower when the underlying TCP implementation is not performing well; (c) Netflix bandwidth consumption can vary by 2x or more when TCP implementations and access networks are changed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the dynamics and implications of the interplay between application-level adaptation and TCP congestion control.
the interplay of TCP and application-based congestion control in a DASH environment.

understanding how the DASH application adapts in the presence of different TCP implementations and different access network conditions, and what implications this may have for network operators and end users.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Netflix bandwidth consumption depends on a variety of factors, including network conditions and the underlying TCP implementation.
the bandwidth consumption of Netflix depends on the network conditions and the TCP implementation used in the access network.
Netflix is a very bandwidth efficient application, but the exact bandwidth consumption is very dependent on the network and application implementation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Netflix is a very efficient application that can adapt to the underlying TCP congestion control mechanisms and that it can achieve high bandwidth utilization.

Netflix is a highly adaptive application that consumes a significant portion of the available bandwidth when the network is lightly loaded and adapts to the underlying TCP mechanisms when network conditions change.
the bandwidth consumption of Netflix is highly dependent on the network conditions, the TCP congestion control algorithm used by the underlying network, and the implementation of the application.

the bandwidth consumption of video streaming can be significantly different depending on the underlying TCP mechanism.
